highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m132/m147, with variable fonts and a reworked lifecycle.
highlights_body: It adds variable font support, animated WebP encoding, color font palettes and several new APIs, and completes the v4 breaking-change story by promoting remaining v3 obsoletes to compile errors. This is a breaking release — read the changes below, especially the Vulkan and default-typeface behaviour changes, before upgrading from 3.x.

breaking.title: Remaining pre-v4 obsolete members promoted to compile errors
breaking.body: SKPaint text/font members and enum values that were marked [Obsolete] in v3 now emit compile errors in v4. Migration: switch to SKFont for text sizing and typeface assignment, and remove references to the removed enum values.

breaking.title: new SKFont() now has an empty typeface, and new SKPaint().Typeface is never null
breaking.body: Upstream removed the lazy 'resolve default at draw time' pattern. new SKFont().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty (MeasureText returns 0) instead of resolving a platform default, so construct with an explicit typeface and detect 'unset' via Typeface.IsEmpty. new SKPaint().Typeface now returns SKTypeface.Default instead of null; code that checked paint.Typeface == null to detect 'no typeface set' should use IsEmpty or drop the check.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName and SKTypeface.Default now resolve through the font manager
breaking.body: FromFamilyName('missing') now returns SKTypeface.Default on every platform (including Android, which previously returned null), and SKTypeface.Default is now guaranteed non-null everywhere, including Android API 36+. For a strict 'was it found?' check, use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name), which still returns null on no match.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) now throws on overflow and is obsolete
breaking.body: The overload always truncated large offsets to a 32-bit int silently. It now performs a checked cast and throws OverflowException for out-of-range values, and is marked [Obsolete] (CS0618). Call Move(int) with an in-range offset instead.

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on a Vulkan 1.0 instance instead of returning null
breaking.body: Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1 and calls SK_ABORT (terminating the process, uncatchable) instead of returning null when the instance or backend context declares a lower version. Declare VK_API_VERSION_1_1 on both the VkInstance's apiVersion and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion — leaving either at its default 0 is unsafe. Vulkan 1.0-only hardware can no longer run Ganesh Vulkan at all; pick another backend up front.

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative loses five interop fields
breaking.body: fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice are removed from the interop struct. Use fVkExtensions instead of fExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 instead of fFeatures; Skia no longer manages instance/device ownership through the backend context. The related GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo property also retypes from GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo, which adds a Components field and loses value-equality (Equals/== are removed).

bullets.lead: Skia upgraded through milestones m132 to m148
bullets.detail: The v4 line's bundled Skia engine moves from m132 through m147 to m148 across the preview cycle, bringing upstream rendering, performance and stability fixes.

bullets.lead: Variable font and color-font support added end-to-end
bullets.detail: SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp gain full variable font support (axis coordinates, named instances) and color font palette selection, plus a new HBColor struct for hb_color_t.

bullets.lead: Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream reads
bullets.detail: SKWebpEncoder can now produce animated WebP output, and SKStream.GetData() converts a stream to SKData without an extra copy.

bullets.lead: SKSamplingOptions support added to surface/canvas drawing
bullets.detail: SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface accept an SKSamplingOptions parameter for finer control over resampling filters.

bullets.lead: Linux Bionic and Tizen x64/arm64 native assets added
bullets.detail: New native asset targets bring SkiaSharp to Linux Bionic and add x64/arm64 native builds for Tizen.
GetPixelSpan now correctly uses RowBytes for stride and the right axis for the pixel offset, instead of the wrong dimension.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalizer crash and WinUI/Uno fixes
bullets.detail: Fixes a finalizer crash in SKPath when its SKPathBuilder is collected first, the WinUI Projection DLL not being found for .NET 9 consumers, a Skottie package downgrade in the Uno gallery sample, and SKGLView not rendering after a MAUI TabBar tab switch on Android.

bullets.lead: Default-typeface resolution moved to the managed layer
bullets.detail: Fixes a crash where SKFontManager could return null on newer Android API levels by moving default-typeface resolution into managed code.

Reworks how SkiaSharp's process-wide singleton instances are created and torn down, and moves the native-compat gate from a module initializer into the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup ordering.
libpng 1.6.58, libexpat 2.7.5/2.8.1, zlib 1.3.2.1-motley, freetype 2.14.3, libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1 and HarfBuzz 14.2.0 all pick up upstream security and bug fixes.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: The Skia m132/m147 bumps, variable font support end-to-end, the managed default-typeface fix, and the SKPath/SKPathBuilder finalizer crash fix
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native assets and PolySharp-based C# 13 support on legacy TFMs
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed SKGLView not rendering after MAUI TabBar tab switches on Android

preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the v4 line: Skia m132 to m133 to m147, variable fonts, color font palettes, SKSamplingOptions on surface draws, the managed default-typeface fix, Tizen x64/arm64, Linux Bionic, and dependency refreshes for libpng/libexpat.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added animated WebP encoding, zero-copy SKStream.GetData(), the SKPath finalizer crash fix, and the Apple TFM realignment.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 finished the API pass with HBColor and missing HarfBuzz wrappers, dropped native WASM builds for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten, and picked up freetype 2.14.3, zlib 1.3.2.1-motley and libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1.
preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: Release Candidate 1 promoted the remaining v3 obsolete members to compile errors, fixed the GetPixelSpan stride/offset bugs, reworked the singleton lifecycle, and updated to Skia m148.

harfbuzz_summary: Adds an HBColor value type, variable-font shaping and color-palette support, and refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.0.

v4.148.0-rc.1.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 Release Candidate 1 finishes the v4 breaking-change pass, on Skia m148.
v4.148.0-rc.1.2.body: It promotes the remaining v3 obsolete SKPaint members to compile errors and reworks the singleton instance lifecycle.

v4.148.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m132 through m148.
v4.148.0.body: It adds variable fonts, animated WebP encoding and color font palettes, and completes the v4 breaking-change story. Vulkan consumers should declare VK_API_VERSION_1_1 before upgrading — see the breaking changes.
